method: Real game cores in Node VM with deterministic speech lifecycle events; no installed OS voice audition.

tests.name: deferred boot mounts the voice toggle in an existing real-core panel once, and rerenders keep delegation and accessibility
spoken text strips nested escapes, HTML, entities, links and markdown; source is unchanged
Russian lesson rotation, male-name commander preference, actual onstart and radio ordering
late voices and no Russian voice use a truthful system fallback
existing voice preference persists; lab lexical storage never touches browser storage
no speech queue; cancellation invalidates old speech callbacks and delayed radio
a stalled radio prefix neither blocks nor restarts spoken preview
pause, hidden tab, scene change and disabled voice stop immediately without muting effects
onstart is required for success, missing starts time out, and unsupported devices fail cleanly
pending preview radio-out is cancelled on close without a late tail or stuck job
real core decision feedback sanitizes why/outcome and academy cards suppress duplicate fallback
real combat step emits rare radio among natural boss warnings and freezes on pause/cards
